小产物不代表零质量风险
多个 Adapter 不能随意相加

div.style: color: rgb(23, 60, 34) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
QLoRA
NF4 量化冻结基础权重
Double Quantization
高精度计算并仅训练 LoRA

div.style: color: rgb(23, 60, 34) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
反馈来源
Human Feedback / RLAIF
规则 / Reward Model / Verifier
偏好标签也可能有噪声

div.style: color: rgb(23, 60, 34) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
拒绝采样
生成多个候选 -> 打分 -> 过滤
优质候选回到 SFT
通常不是 Policy-Gradient RL

div.style: color: rgb(23, 60, 34) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
偏好对
Prompt + Chosen + Rejected
来自人工、AI、规则或验证器

div.style: color: rgb(23, 60, 34) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
DPO
Policy 与 Reference Log-Ratio
离线直接优化 Chosen 偏好
依赖偏好数据覆盖

div.style: color: rgb(23, 60, 34) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
RLHF + PPO
Online Rollout -> Reward
Critic / Advantage / Clip / KL
可探索但系统复杂

div.style: color: rgb(23, 60, 34) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
GRPO
同 Prompt 生成一组响应
规则或 Reward 打分
组内标准化 Advantage

div.style: color: rgb(48, 41, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
领域或对齐模型
能力 + 行为 + 安全约束

div.style: color: rgb(74, 40, 17) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
Prefill
一次处理完整 Prompt
生成各层历史 K/V
长 Prompt 影响 TTFT

div.style: color: rgb(74, 40, 17) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
KV Cache
单请求复用历史 Key/Value
避免每步重算旧 Token
以显存换 Decode 计算

div.style: color: rgb(74, 40, 17) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
Decode
每步输入新 Token
读取并追加 KV Cache
常受显存带宽限制

div.style: color: rgb(74, 40, 17) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
下一 Token 概率分布
Logits -> Softmax
P(next token | prefix)
累加序列 Log Probability

div.style: color: rgb(74, 40, 17) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
解码策略
Greedy / Beam Search / Sampling
EOS / Length Penalty / Repetition
Constrained Generation

div.style: color: rgb(74, 40, 17) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
采样控制
Temperature 调整尖锐度
Top-K 固定候选数
Top-P 累计概率集合
截断后重新归一化

div.style: color: rgb(74, 40, 17) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
多候选与加速
Self-Consistency 多样本投票
Speculative Decode 草稿加验证
后者优化执行而非搜索目标

div.style: color: rgb(74, 40, 17) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
Prompt / Prefix Cache
跨请求复用兼容的前缀 KV
模型 / Adapter / Token / 位置
多模态输入与租户隔离

div.style: color: rgb(74, 40, 17) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
缓存与调度技术
PagedAttention / Paged KV
Radix Prefix Cache
Continuous Batching / Chunked Prefill

div.style: color: rgb(74, 40, 17) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
量化维度
Weight / Activation / KV / Optimizer
对称或非对称 / Scale / Zero Point
Per-Tensor / Channel / Group

div.style: color: rgb(74, 40, 17) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
量化方案与格式
INT8 / INT4 / GPTQ / AWQ / NF4
GGUF / Safetensors / Kernel
更小不保证一定更快

div.style: color: rgb(47, 31, 73) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
Prompt 输入契约
Role / Task / Context
Evidence Boundary / Output Schema
Few-shot Examples / 防注入边界

div.style: color: rgb(47, 31, 73) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
Prompt 工程闭环
结构化输出 + Parser 校验
Version / Golden Set / 失败分类
Retry / Canary / A-B / 压缩

div.style: color: rgb(47, 31, 73) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
Chain-of-Thought
Zero-shot / Few-shot CoT
Scratchpad / Hidden Reasoning
中间文字不一定忠实

div.style: color: rgb(47, 31, 73) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
推理增强
Self-Consistency
Tool-Augmented Reasoning
Process Supervision / External Verifier
更多 Token 带来成本与延迟

div.style: color: rgb(47, 31, 73) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
幻觉类型
Factuality / Faithfulness
Context Consistency / Execution Error
流畅不代表正确

div.style: color: rgb(47, 31, 73) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
幻觉成因
训练数据与 Next-Token 目标
知识过期 / 解码随机性
检索、工具或上下文失败

div.style: color: rgb(47, 31, 73) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
Grounding 与缓解
RAG / Tool / Citation Validation
Claim-Evidence Entailment
拒答 / 澄清 / 人工复核

div.style: color: rgb(47, 31, 73) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
不确定性治理
Confidence Calibration / ECE
按风险分级阈值
目标是测量和降低，不承诺归零

div.style: color: rgb(21, 56, 56) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
工作负载画像
GPU / CPU / Edge
模型格式 / 上下文长度 / 并发
共享前缀 / 量化 / 运维能力

div.style: color: rgb(21, 56, 56) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
部署框架
vLLM / SGLang / TGI
llama.cpp / TensorRT-LLM
必须按模型与硬件实测

div.style: color: rgb(21, 56, 56) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
Serving 能力
Continuous Batching / Paged KV
Prefix Cache / Chunked Prefill
Speculative Decode / Quantized Kernel

div.style: color: rgb(21, 56, 56) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
Serving SLO
TTFT / TPOT 或 ITL
Throughput / Goodput
错误率 / 可用性 / 峰值显存

div.style: color: rgb(74, 30, 42) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
三层评测
Public Benchmark
业务 Golden Set
Shadow / Canary / Online A-B

div.style: color: rgb(74, 30, 42) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
任务质量指标
Accuracy / Precision / Recall / F1
Pass@K / Exact Match
RAG Hit@K / MRR / Citation
Agent 成功率与 Tool 正确率

div.style: color: rgb(74, 30, 42) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
系统与风险指标
鲁棒性 / 安全 / Calibration
Latency / Throughput / Cost
人工修改率 / 拒答正确率

div.style: color: rgb(74, 30, 42) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
评测可信度
LLM-as-Judge 偏差
人工标定 / 数据污染
Paired Test / Bootstrap / 置信区间

div.style: color: rgb(74, 30, 42) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
硬门禁
合规 / 数据驻留 / 功能
Context / Tool / SLO / Budget
不满足者先淘汰

div.style: color: rgb(74, 30, 42) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
多目标选型
质量 / 延迟 / 吞吐 / 总成本
硬件与运维 / Pareto Frontier
Token 单价不等于总成本

div.style: color: rgb(74, 30, 42) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
Model Routing
Provider + Model + Version 身份
Allowlist / Dynamic Route / Fallback
缓存、重试和降级也计入成本

div.style: color: rgb(74, 30, 42) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
失败样本回流
更新 Prompt / RAG / Tool
补充 SFT 或 Preference Data
调整阈值、路由与发布策略

div.style: color: rgb(45, 39, 21) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
模型输出
文本 / JSON / Tool Call
